abstract: Reviews perimeter emergency vehicular access clearance and multi-vehicle mass evacuation transit staging capabilities
system_message:
You are the Emergency transport planner (LOG). Your responsibilities include reviewing perimeter emergency vehicular access clearance along designated primary roadways and evaluating multi-vehicle mass evacuation transit staging capabilities at shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evacuation transport staging（EVAC）
information_points.content:
LOG-EVAC-MIP：The primary arrival apron at Bolinas Lagoon Regional Recreation Center features 6 dedicated bus embarkation bays capable of simultaneously staging standard 40-foot transit buses, according to the transit staging layout schematic.
LOG-EVAC-2K8：The transit staging layout schematic for Inverness Ridge Civic Gymnasium confirms that the shelter primary arrival apron provides 4 dedicated bus embarkation bays for standard 40-foot transit buses.
LOG-EVAC-R18：At the Point Reyes Coastal Community Pavilion primary arrival apron, the transit staging layout schematic indicates a capacity of 2 dedicated bus embarkation bays accommodating standard 40-foot transit buses simultaneously.

information_points.title: Reviews perimeter emergency vehicular access clearance and multi-vehicle mass evacuation transit staging capabilities（ROAD）
information_points.content:
LOG-ROAD-JZF：The fire marshal road access inspection confirms that Inverness Ridge Civic Gymnasium maintains emergency access lane clearance across its designated primary perimeter access roadway, providing an unobstructed minimum 20-foot wide all-weather emergency vehicle ingress route.
LOG-ROAD-46W：According to the fire marshal road access inspection along the designated primary perimeter access roadway, Point Reyes Coastal Community Pavilion has verified emergency access lane clearance, maintaining an unobstructed minimum 20-foot wide all-weather ingress route.
LOG-ROAD-CZ2：Based on the fire marshal road access inspection for the designated primary perimeter access roadway, Bolinas Lagoon Regional Recreation Center does not have emergency access lane clearance, failing to provide an unobstructed minimum 20-foot wide all-weather emergency vehicle route.
